name: Jared W. Julian
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Flower Mound, Texas
education: Texas A&M University School of Law
about: As the founder and president of JulianJohnson, PC in Flower Mound, Texas, attorney Jared W. Julian provides invaluable counsel and support to clients throughout Denton and Collin counties and the surrounding areas who are going through a divorce or have some other serious family law issue they need to address.

Board-certified in family law by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization and possessing more than 22 years of family law legal experience, Mr. Julian has helped thousands of clients protect their rights and interests and achieve the favorable outcomes they expect and deserve. He has extensive experience handling high-asset divorces, contentious child custody matters, complex property division, Child Protective Services cases, adoptions, juvenile law matters and many other domestic-related issues.

A highly trained mediator with a reported success rate of more than 95%, Mr. Julian prefers to help his clients resolve their conflicts and reach settlements in the most efficient and amicable manner possible. However, he also understands that not all divorce-related issues can be handled through mediation, and he is fully prepared to take his clients' cases to court when necessary.

Recognized for his exemplary professionalism and outstanding service to his clients, Mr. Julian has earned consistent designation from his peers as being among the top 5% of family law attorneys in his region. In 2022 and 2023, he was named to the elite Top 100 Lawyers in DFW by SuperLawyers. He has also received many positive testimonials, reviews and referrals from his satisfied clients, and he finds great reward in being able to help so many during what is such a difficult and emotional time in their lives.

Before pursuing his legal degree, Mr. Julian earned a Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice and worked as a licensed Peace Officer in Texas for several years. He then attended Texas Wesleyan University School of Law (now Texas A&M University School of Law), where he obtained his Juris Doctor in 2001. While there, he was an active member of the Student Bar Association, serving as a board member and president of the organization, and he also served as associate editor for the Texas Wesleyan Law Review.

Throughout the course of his career, Mr. Julian has remained active in his legal community, and he is a member of the State Bar of Texas, the American Bar Association and the Denton County Bar Association, among his other professional affiliations.
